title: Gateway user-message stream
responsibility: Converts conversation history and image references into one SDK user message.

inputs.name: gatewayMessages.request
inputs.description: A GatewayRequest with a string model, stream=true, input records, tools, and optional instructions; this function serializes input before embedding it in the prompt and extracting image blocks. Serialization rejects nesting beyond 32 levels, unsupported audio/video/file attachments or binary resources, invalid image blocks, more than 20 images, or more than 20 MiB of image bytes.

outputs.name: gatewayMessages
outputs.description: An async generator that yields one SDK user message when consumed, with a prompt text block followed by one image block per serialized image. The prompt includes the ordered serialized history and one-based image-reference guidance, and the message has parent_tool_use_id set to null.

errors.name: GatewayContentError
errors.description: Thrown when history serialization exceeds 32 levels of nesting, encounters unsupported audio/video/file attachments or binary resources, receives missing or invalid image bytes, exceeds the 5 MiB per-image limit, or exceeds the 20-image or 20 MiB per-request limit.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown while building the prompt if JSON.stringify encounters a BigInt in the serialized input history.
